Annotation.String: This is the schema definition for the Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) mode of a switch.

This resource shall represent the Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) mode of a switch. TAV is a firmware-controlled power optimization that dynamically adjusts the switch ASIC core supply voltage based on ASIC temperature while maintaining a fixed operating frequency.
The TAV mode is changed by a PATCH on the associated settings resource; the new value is applied on the next device reset.
Reset the TAV mode to the default.
This action shall request the default TAV mode. The resolved pending mode shall be reported in the settings resource and shall take effect on the next device reset.
The available actions for this resource.
This property shall contain the available actions for this resource.
The Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) mode of the switch.

This property shall contain the Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) mode of the switch as `Enabled` or `Disabled`. When enabled, firmware monitors ASIC temperature and may reduce the ASIC core supply voltage below its nominal boot voltage according to internal temperature conditions and hysteresis, restoring nominal voltage when those conditions no longer apply. When disabled, firmware does not perform temperature-based voltage reduction and the ASIC remains at its nominal boot voltage. The switch continues operating at fixed frequency, so this mode affects power consumption rather than link speed or switching capacity. The mode applies per switch ASIC. On the active resource this property is read-only and reflects the currently effective mode. On the settings resource a client may PATCH `Enabled` or `Disabled`; use the `ResetToDefaults` action to request the default. The settings resource reports the resolved pending mode that applies on the next device reset.

This value shall indicate that Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) is enabled and that firmware may reduce the switch ASIC core supply voltage below its nominal boot voltage when the ASIC temperature meets the internally configured threshold and hysteresis conditions.
This value shall indicate that Temperature Aware Voltage (TAV) is disabled and that the switch ASIC remains at its nominal boot voltage with no temperature-based voltage reduction applied.
The available actions for this resource.
This type shall contain the available actions for this resource.
